name: Tequila Sunrise
source: After sustaining a career-ending injury, Manchester Wanderers Midfielder Robert Finch is at a loss what to do with his life. A mid-afternoon pint at his local pub and a chance meeting with a beautiful business magnate leads to a new opportunity for this hapless ex-athlete.
